QuestInfo.2: The Dark Lord seems to be starting to trust you. At least, he told you to keep working hard so you can help the people of Kerning City. Excellent, things are going according to plan.

0.0: Let's see if you have it in you to battle the #rStirges#k that live in the Subway. They're agile, quick, clever... Everything you're not.

yes.0: Defeat #r60#k Stirges in the #bSubway#k. Do not return until the task is done.

no.0: I knew it you were a lazy good-for-nothing the moment I saw you.

1.0: Perhaps I misjudged you. I apologize. Things have been tense lately, and I may have taken my anger out on you. You have my blessing to aid the citizens of Kerning City, young Thief.

mob.0: The #rStirges#k have not been eliminated yet...
